name: VIXI: I have lived
author: AKATA_RYUUKO
description: Within each level, the player can collect items and interact with objects to solve puzzles, some items may require the player to win a mini rhythm game before collecting the item. After all puzzles in the level are solved, the player can collect a special item. The player can pass each level by scoring enough points in the main rhythm game by fighting with the boss NPC, the special items they collect will help them score higher.
